name: NoDataMessage
description: A centered empty-state message component that displays an Info icon inside a circular muted badge, a title, and a descriptive message. Used to communicate that no data is available for a given view or query.

props.name: title
props.description: The heading text displayed below the info icon (e.g. "No results found").

props.name: message
props.description: A secondary descriptive message displayed below the title in muted text (e.g. "Try adjusting your filters").

accessibility.role: Presentational container (div). No implicit ARIA role.
accessibility.aria: No explicit ARIA attributes. The content is conveyed through visible heading and paragraph text.
accessibility.notes: The Info icon is purely decorative. The component centers its content vertically and horizontally with p-8 padding and rounded-md border radius.
